summary: Undefeated Kansas City (28.0 ppg, 160 rush ypg) is a +3 dog to Seattle despite the better point differential; the total fell 45.5 to 42.5. Most likely: Chiefs +3 (-118).

extra_legs.note: Kansas City's +11.4 point margin and Walker's league-best rushing beat Darnold's 27th-ranked EPA, and 3 is the key number.
A dog price on the better offense: Mahomes and Reid are unbeaten while Seattle is 3-3 after losing to Denver.
Two top defenses, Rice out for KC and 47% rain chance, but my projection (43.5) and recent Seattle games lean the other way.

totals_projection.math: KC avg(28.0, SEA allows 20.3)=24.2; SEA avg(24.7, KC allows 16.6)=20.7; sum 44.9, minus ~1.4 for rain (47%, 56F) and Rice out. Slightly above 42.5, so no Under edge.

research:
SEARCH NOTE: about 12 WebSearch calls plus the ESPN summary API (WebFetch fails with DNS errors). No Walker/Mahomes/Kelce/JSN prop price was found for this game (only stale or other-game lines), so no prop legs are offered. Final inactives not posted when searched.
1) Game: Chiefs at Seahawks, Sunday Night Football 8:20 PM ET on NBC, Lumen Field. The defending champion Seahawks are 3-3; Kansas City is undefeated (AP via ESPN).
2) Market (DK via ESPN): SEA -3 (-102), KC +3 (-118), ML SEA -148/KC +124, total 42.5 (-110/-110). Opened SEA -3 (-105), ML -155/+130, total 45.5. SI: opened SEA -1.5, BetMGM SEA -2.5 and ML -140/+115, total 42.5.
3) No-vig: DK KC ML 0.428, BetMGM 0.444, Kalshi KC about 45%, so I used 0.44. KC +3 fair 0.517. Total fair 0.50 (Kalshi under 52%).
4) Line movement: total down three points, 45.5 to 42.5, while the spread held near 3; no public/sharp splits found.
5) Models and experts: Kalshi (Covers) SEA 54-55%; Covers early pick Seahawks ML and Under; BetMGM preview Seahawks ML -130; SI (Road to 272) backs the Chiefs as a dog citing Darnold's 27th adjusted EPA/play and 16th CPOE; Squawka KC 24-23 (editorial).
6) QBs: Mahomes 105/158 (66.5%), 1,309 yds, 9 TD, 3 INT, 103.1 rating; Darnold 90/149, 1,033 yds, 7 TD, 7 INT. ESPN lists backup Drew Lock questionable; Darnold missed Week 2 with a glute injury earlier but is listed as the starter (leaders).
7) Injuries: KC WR Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring), OT Jaylon Moore OUT, CB Sneed questionable, OT Simmons and RB Smith IR, WR Thornton out 12-16 weeks. SEA LB Surratt and LB Drake Thomas OUT, S Emmanwori questionable, TE Arroyo IR, rookie RB Price out; RB Charbonnet (ACL return) activated and may play.
8) Stats (ESPN): KC 28.0 ppg, 421.6 ypg, 159.8 rush ypg; allows 16.6 ppg, 88.8 rush, 224 pass ypg. SEA 24.7 ppg, 352 ypg, 107 rush; allows 20.3 ppg, 252.8 ypg, 156.8 pass ypg (best), 96 rush.
9) Players: Walker (ex-SEA Super Bowl MVP) 106-665-6, league-high 133 rush ypg, 128 yds vs LAC; Kelce 20-299-2; JSN 49-717-7 (78 yds last time out per NBC); SEA RB Emanuel Wilson 87-303-2.
10) Coaching: Reid (KC) on offense; Macdonald is a defensive play-caller whose 2025 unit allowed an NFL-best 17.2 ppg. Spagnuolo's KC defense is top-10 in points allowed.
11) Weather (ESPN/AccuWeather): 56F, 47% precipitation, wind gust 9 mph. Light rain at most; mild effect on deep passing.
12) Trends: SI: Over is 4-1 in the last five meetings; FanDuel Research: SEA games went Over 3 of 6. SEA game totals 38, 64, 53, 61, 31; KC 28, 57, 34, 63, 41.
13) Recent form: KC 22-6 vs LAC, 33-30 OT vs IND, 24-10 at MIA, 30-27 at LV, 31-10 vs DEN. SEA lost 17-14 OT at DEN, 32-29 vs SF, beat LAC 30-23, lost 33-31 at WSH, beat ARI 31-7.
14) Calibration: KC +3 and ML priced at DK plus BetMGM/Kalshi checks; Under 42.5 has no edge versus my 43.5 projection, so it is a weak leg and flagged.
15) Most likely to win: Chiefs +3 (-118): KC wins outright about 44% and loses by 1-2 about 12%.
